disclaimer: Fictional teaching rules; not food-safety or operating guidance.

rules.text: For this exercise, a cargo reading outside 0 to 4 C needs human review. At exactly 4 C the upper limit has not been exceeded.
rules.action: Ask the dispatcher to verify the sensor and contact the driver.

rules.text: Missing, future-dated or older-than-60-minute telemetry cannot establish current cargo status.
rules.action: Obtain a fresh validated sensor reading; do not infer a safe current state.

rules.text: High Risk with delay probability greater than 0.65 needs manager review.
rules.action: Ask the dispatcher to escalate to the duty manager.

rules.text: A temperature breach with a verified delay greater than one hour needs a human to assess cold-storage alternatives.
rules.action: Ask the dispatcher to assess an alternative cold-storage location.
